ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior for nodes that have not upgraded when the fork activates.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume non-upgraded nodes will reject post-Homestead blocks as invalid, causing a chain split until they upgrade.

ambiguities.text: Block >= 0 on future testnets is vague about which testnets this applies to.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this means any testnet created after Homestead activation should enable Homestead rules from genesis.

implicit_assumptions.description: A sufficient majority of network nodes will upgrade before the activation block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could experience a contentious hard fork with significant hash power on the old chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: The activation block number was chosen to give adequate time for coordination and upgrades.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Insufficient time could lead to unintentional chain splits and confusion among users.
